_comment: Stage 1.1 teacher SFT, paper recipe: 8 ranks x accumulation 1 (global batch 8), 5000 steps, AdamW lr 1e-5 with 10 warm-up steps. Paths come from scripts/stage1_1_transfer/train.sh (or --cache-root/--transformer/--output-dir/--base-model). With N < 8 GPUs set accumulation = 8 / N to keep the global batch.
